content_sections.heading: Farrukhabad Anganwadi Sahayika Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 140 posts of Anganwadi Sahayika are vacant across eight Child Development Project areas of Farrukhabad district. The project-wise vacancy and reservation breakup is given below. The notification does not mention any vacancies reserved for the ST category or for persons with disabilities; only Unreserved, OBC, and SC break-ups are given for each project area.

content_sections.heading: Farrukhabad Anganwadi Sahayika Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only female candidates are eligible to apply for these posts. A candidate must be an original resident of the Gram Sabha or Ward (in urban areas) against which the post is vacant. Preference in selection is given to a widow, legally divorced woman, or an abandoned (deserted) woman belonging to a family living below the poverty line (BPL) in that Gram Sabha/Ward. If no such widow/divorced/abandoned BPL candidate is available in that Gram Sabha/Ward, other women from a BPL family in the same Gram Sabha/Ward are eligible. If no BPL widow/divorced/abandoned or other BPL woman candidate is available, women from an above-poverty-line (APL) family residing in the same Gram Sabha/Ward are eligible.

content_sections.heading: Farrukhabad Anganwadi Sahayika Qualification
content_sections.text: The minimum educational qualification for the post of Anganwadi Sahayika is Intermediate (12th) or an equivalent qualification. Candidates with a higher qualification, up to postgraduate level, will have their merit prepared on that basis. The percentage of marks obtained by a candidate is divided by 10, and the resulting score is used for merit preparation.

content_sections.heading: Farrukhabad Anganwadi Sahayika Age Limit
content_sections.text: As on 1 July 2026, a candidate's age must not be less than 18 years and not more than 35 years. The notification does not mention any age relaxation for reserved categories.

rows.details: Date of birth as recorded in the High School mark sheet/certificate only

content_sections.heading: Farrukhabad Anganwadi Sahayika Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification states that the selection process will be carried out based on the decisions and government orders issued by the District Magistrate and the Selection Committee. Specific stages of selection (such as written exam, interview, or merit list criteria beyond the marks-based formula mentioned above) are not specified in the provided notification. The number of vacancies is also subject to increase or decrease based on any court case, order, or decision of the Selection Committee.

content_sections.heading: Farrukhabad Anganwadi Sahayika Required Documents
content_sections.text: Residence certificate - only an online, digitally signed certificate issued by the Tehsil, verifiable online, is valid. Caste certificate - only an online, digitally signed certificate issued by the Tehsil, verifiable online, is valid. Income certificate - a certificate issued by the competent authority as per UP Government Revenue Section-09 Order No. 3959/1-9-11-Ra0-9 dated 30.09.2011 (or a lower-level valid certificate), verifiable online. High School mark sheet/certificate, for proof of date of birth. For a widow candidate: death certificate and family register copy certified by the Gram Panchayat Officer or the concerned Nagar Nikay (Municipal Body). For a divorced/abandoned candidate: only an order issued by a court of law is valid proof. Self-attested, clear, and legible scanned copies of all relevant documents, as mentioned in the online application form. faq.question: Q1. What is Farrukhabad Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a direct recruitment drive by the District Programme Officer, Farrukhabad, to fill 140 contractual, honorarium-based posts of Anganwadi Sahayika in the urban and rural Child Development Project areas of Farrukhabad district.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Farrukhabad Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 140 vacancies are available across eight project areas: Badhpur, Shamsabad, Shahar, Kamalganj, Kaimganj, Nawabganj, Rajepur, and Mohammadabad.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Farrukhabad Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 19 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Farrukhabad Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is Intermediate (12th) or equivalent. Candidates with higher qualifications, up to postgraduate level, are also considered, with merit based on marks percentage divided by 10.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Farrukhabad Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on 1 July 2026, based on the date of birth recorded in their High School mark sheet/certificate.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for Farrukhabad Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is not specified in the provided notification.
